query: SELECT cm.id, cm.slug, cm.title, cm.isPublished, COUNT(cl.id) as totalLessons, SUM(CASE WHEN cl.isPublished = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as publishedLessons FROM course_modules cm LEFT JOIN course_lessons cl ON cl.moduleId = cm.id GROUP BY cm.id, cm.slug, cm.title, cm.isPublished ORDER BY cm.id;
